subject: Dr. Bowow
text: Dr. Bowow mechanizes the Chocobo's wounded leg to create the Chocobot, allowing it to travel by water.

evidence.quote: Dr. Bowow will tell you that he mechanized the Chocobo’s wounded leg and can travel by water! He named it the Chocobot!

subject: Ish Inn
text: Resting at the Inn in Ish costs 10 G.

evidence.quote: so head to the Inn and pay a small amount (10 G) to rest.

subject: Chocobot
text: Using a wooden dock allows the player to enter the water and walk on water using the Chocobot.

evidence.quote: Now, you can walk on water when you use the dock. Just put your chocobot on the docks and simply enter the water.

subject: Snowman Puzzle
text: Stepping on the upper right switch moves the snowman along sliding floors so it can be pushed north onto a floor switch to open the right door.

evidence.quote: On the north room, you’ll see a lot of sliding floors and a snowman. Now, step on the upper right switch. A sliding floor will appear beneath the snowman. The snowman will now travel through the sliding floors until in reaches the end. Now, push it north onto the floor switch. The door on the right should now be open.

subject: Cave of Snowfields
text: Defeating all enemies in the room causes a chest containing an Elixir to appear in the center.

evidence.quote: Kill all the enemies in this room. A chest will appear in the center. Now, get it for an elixir.

subject: Sliding Floor Switch
text: Hitting the middle poles with the flail and stepping on the switch removes part of the sliding floor, allowing access to the lower right floor switch that opens the door.

evidence.quote: In this room, walk to the sliding floor and use your flail on the poles in the middle. After that, step in the switch. A portion of the sliding floors will disappear. You can now step on the lower right floor switch. The door will now open.

subject: Kary
text: Defeating Kary awards 183 EXP and 129 GP, with the Flame Flail listed as the preferred weapon.

evidence.quote:
EXP gained:         183
GP:                 129
Attacks:            Icicle, Charging Tail attack
Preferred Weapon:   Flame Flail

subject: Flame Shield
text: Equipping the Flame Shield blocks all icicle projectiles thrown by Kary.

evidence.quote: If you have the Flame Shield, it can block ALL of the Icicles that are thrown at you.

subject: Kary
text: A chest appears in the middle of the room after defeating Kary containing the Ice Sword.

evidence.quote: After beating Kary, a chest will appear in the middle. Now, examine it and you’ll receive the Ice Sword.

subject: Cibba
text: Speaking to Cibba in Lorim with a free inventory slot grants the Bone Key.

evidence.quote: Make sure you have a slot which is free in your Items Inventory. If there is, talk to Cibba. You’ll receive the Bone Key right away.

subject: Morning Star
text: The Morning Star can destroy Floating Rocks blocking the path.

evidence.quote: Now, you should see some Floating Rocks so, equip your Morning Star as it can destroy these rocks.

subject: Thunder Spear
text: The Thunder Spear is available for purchase at the weapon shop near Floatrocks for 11250.

evidence.quote: You’ll see a Weapon shop here. I suggest you go in and buy the Thunder Spear. You should have enough money by now. It costs 11250 you know.

subject: Cave of Floatrocks Switches
text: In the Cave of Floatrocks, destroy the rocks to step on the upper switch, then destroy the rocks below to step on the lower switch.

evidence.quote: Now, destroy the rocks and step on the upper switch. And then, destroy the rocks below and step on the lower switch.
